budget_items.topic: Low-Income Community Solar discount on electricity supply
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A proposed automatic discount of about 4 cents per kWh for Unitil low-income customers, taking a customer from about 12.9 cents to about 8.9 cents per kWh.
budget_items.quote: would automatically receive an additional approximately 4-cent-per-kilowatt-hour discount off the aggregation supply rate

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Member Moore noted the existing Unitil low-income discount is about 38%, to which the solar discount would be additive.
budget_items.quote: is approximately 38%, to which this solar discount would be additive.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Committee report noted substitute teacher pay was increased.
The School Committee report noted health insurance projections of potential increases.
budget_items.quote: health insurance projections of potentially 20% increases
